justification: Assessment reported INVALID at step 0003 and targeted exactly the ground-truth defect: the claim that after removing a cycle C the remainder on n-|C| vertices with n-1-|C| edges has at least |C|+1 components. Its witness (triangle on {a,b,c} plus isolated vertex d, n=4, 3 edges, |C|=3, remainder = 1 vertex with 1 component vs asserted 4) is the same minimal witness as the ground truth. It additionally noted the edge-bookkeeping error in the same sentence, which is part of the same defect.
